camel_example: aliyun cbn ListTransitRouters --region cn-hangzhou --Status Active --Tag.1.Key TagKey --Type Enterprise --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value TagValue --FeatureFilter.1.Key Multicast --CenId 'cen-j3jzhw1zpau2km0000' --TransitRouterName testname --FeatureFilter.1.Value.1 Enabled --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --TransitRouterId 'tr-uf654ttymmljlvh2x0000'
description_en: Queries information about transit router instances under a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance, including the instance type, instance status, transit router instance ID, and whether the multicast feature is enabled
description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouters接口查询云企业网实例下转发路由器实例的实例类型、实例的状态、转发路由器实例ID、是否开启了组播功能等信息
kebab_example: aliyun cbn list-transit-routers --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --cen-id cen-j3jzhw1zpau2km0000 --transit-router-id tr-uf654ttymmljlvh2x0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --tag Value=TagValue Key=TagKey --status Active --type Enterprise --transit-router-name testname --feature-filter '[{"Value":["Enabled"],"Key":"Multicast"}]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTransitRouters

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 10. For more information about paging, see the related parameter descriptions
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数。取值范围：1~50。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the transit router instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
转发路由器实例所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource.

The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`或者`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https:// `。

一次最多支持输入20个标签的标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource.

The tag value can be an empty string or up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

Each tag key corresponds to one tag value. You can specify up to 20 tag values at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。

标签值可以为空或输入不超过128个字符的字符串，不能以`aliyun`或者`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https:// `。

每一个标签键对应一个标签值，一次最多支持输入20个标签键对应的标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The tag information.

You can specify up to 20 tags at a time
parameters.help_zh:
标签信息。

一次最多支持输入20个标签信息
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The status of the transit router instance. Valid values:

Creating: being created.
Active: active.
Modifying: being modified.
Deleting: being deleted.
Upgrading: being upgraded
parameters.help_zh:
转发路由器实例的状态。

Creating：创建中。
Active：可用。
Modifying：修改中。
Deleting：删除中。
Upgrading：升级中
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The type of the transit router instance. Valid values:

Enterprise: Enterprise Edition transit router.
Basic: Basic Edition transit router
parameters.help_zh:
转发路由器实例的类型。

Enterprise：企业版。
Basic：基础版
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the transit router instance.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
转发路由器实例的名称。

名称长度为1~128个字符不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: transit_router_name

fields.help_en:
The key of the feature filter for transit routers. Currently supported fields:
Multicast: the multicast feature
fields.help_zh:
转发路由器功能筛选字段键值。
目前支持字段：
Multicast：组播功能
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The list of values for the feature filter of transit routers. When the key is Multicast, only one value is supported. Valid values:
Enabled: multicast is supported.
Disabled: multicast is not supported
fields.help_zh:
转发路由器功能筛选字段值列表。
当键值为Multicast时，只支持填入1个字段，支持字段内容为：
Enabled：支持组播。
Disabled：不支持组播
fields.name: value
